usage: Level-up spell list for the listed classes. Combat runs it only when a wired ability has the same id.

srd.text:
_Level 1 Necromancy (Cleric)_

**Casting Time:** Action
**Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S
**Duration:** Instantaneous

A creature you touch makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

_Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot._ The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.
